name: website-rebuild
title_zh: 镜像取证式复刻获奖创意网站，逐行可溯源
tagline_zh: 给一个 URL，还你一个像素级孪生。WebGL、滚动动画、作品集站点，连压缩混淆的 bundle 都能拆到行号级。
tagline_en: Drop a URL, get a pixel-twin. WebGL, scroll-anim, portfolio sites—minified bundles traced to line numbers.
desc_en: 1:1 rebuild of award-winning creative websites (WebGL / scroll-animation / portfolio sites). Evidence-driven pipeline - mirror-first forensics, line-number-traceable reverse engineering of minified bundles, verbatim porting, quantitative verification gates. Use when user asks to "复刻网站", "重建网站", "1:1 rebuild", "clone this site", or provides a URL of a creative/award site to reproduce.
why_zh: 不是照着截图重画，而是先镜像取证、再对压缩产物做行号级逆向。
why_en: No eyeballing. Mirror-first forensics, line-number reverse engineering, verbatim porting, then quantitative gates—so 'close'.
limit_zh: 只认公开可访问的静态创意站点；需要目标站无登录墙且资源可直连。动态数据、后端接口、反爬资源一律不碰，产物止于前端还原。
limit_en: Public static creative sites only; no login walls or blocked assets. Dynamic data, APIs, anti-scraping resources are out. Output stops at front-end.
title_en: Forensic 1:1 rebuild of award-winning creative sites
